What We Stand For

Our Key Initiatives

🎓

Youth Excellence

Scholarship programs and leadership training empower our youth to become future leaders and achieve excellence in all spheres of life.

🕌

Mosque Construction

Our flagship project — building a permanent mosque at 475 Springfield Ave, Newark, NJ — a spiritual home for families and friends across New Jersey.

🤲

Community Outreach

Organizing community events, civic engagement, and outreach programs that welcome neighbors of all backgrounds and foster full participation in our shared community life.

💪

Community Empowerment

Empowering vulnerable members with startup grants, job training, and resources to fight poverty and promote economic independence across our community.

Our Values

United in Faith

"وَاعْتَصِمُوا بِحَبْلِ اللَّهِ جَمِيعًا وَلَا تَفَرَّقُوا"
"And hold firmly to the rope of Allah all together and do not become divided." — Qur'an 3:103

The Foundation of Our Community
01

Taqwa

Consciousness of Allah in every action, guiding our decisions and purifying our intentions as individuals and as a community.

02

Ukhuwwah

Brotherhood and sisterhood across all ethnic and cultural backgrounds — because the believers are one family in the sight of Allah.

03

'Ilm

Seeking knowledge as an act of worship. We invest in Islamic education for every generation, from toddlers to elders.

04

Khidmah

Service to our neighbors and society as an expression of our deen. We care for the vulnerable and give back to New Jersey.

Who We Are

Faith, Service &
Community in NJ

Haali-Pular New Jersey (HPNJ), publicly operating as the Fouta Islamic Center of New Jersey (FICNJ), is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organized exclusively for charitable, religious, and educational purposes. We exist to nurture faith, strengthen community, and serve our neighbors with compassion and sincerity.

Our doors are open to every Muslim and every neighbor who walks through them. We welcome all backgrounds, all walks of life, and all who seek a place of prayer, learning, and belonging. Membership and participation are open to everyone who supports our mission — regardless of background or origin.

Our flagship project is the construction of a permanent mosque at 475 Springfield Avenue, Newark, NJ 07103 — a spiritual home for worship, education, and brotherhood, and a beacon of Islamic values for all of New Jersey.
